item.title: UPDATED: GoFundMe page set up for Peoria County deputy shot during traffic stop
item.description: Deputy Jack Evans, 24, was shot in both legs and his torso after a traffic stop on Saturday night and is in good spirits while remaining under medical care.

item.title: UPDATED: Peoria High basketball coach on leave after arrest for allegedly soliciting a minor
item.description: A Peoria Public School employee, Daniel C. Ruffin, was arrested for indecent solicitation of a 16-year-old female student after inappropriate text messages were found on the girl's phone.

item.title: Police officer, one other hospitalized after Downtown Peoria wreck
item.description: A traffic collision involving a Peoria Police squad vehicle caused a heavy police presence in Downtown Peoria, resulting in one person being taken to the hospital.

item.title: Peoria launchs new 'Community Reminder' series
item.description: The City of Peoria has launched a new public service announcement series, beginning with a video on home winter temperature safety tips, available on the city's YouTube page.

item.title: Limestone High hosts 50th annual Easterseals fundraiser kickoff
item.description: Limestone Community High School held its 50th annual Easterseals fundraising kickoff, started by a social studies teacher in 1977 to teach students selflessness, with the goal of raising money to help kids with developmental delays, disabilities, or other special needs.

item.title: Peoria seeks restraining order against Par-A-Dice casino vote
item.description: The city of Peoria is filing a lawsuit to block a vote by the Illinois Gaming Board on a proposal to revamp and redo the Par-A-Dice Casino Hotel, citing violations of the Illinois Riverboat Gambling Act and an intergovernmental agreement with East Peoria.

item.title: YWCA's Labyrinth program shifts focus, ends Labyrinth Made Goods
item.description: The YWCA is shifting their Labyrinth Reentry Services Program from a reactive to proactive style, offering housing, career services and job experience to help formerly incarcerated individuals transition back into society, while also discontinuing their 'Labyrinth Made Goods' program.

item.title: Bloomington Performing Arts Center rises in national rankings
item.description: The Bloomington Center of the Performing Arts has been recognized as a top ten venue in the US for ticket sales in December, based on its size, and is hoping to climb higher in the rankings in the next year.
